description: Edits of the audit procedure files made after audit records pinned their SHA-256. Each change gives the exact reverse edit, so that a validator recovers the bytes an audit used from the current file. procedure_changes.py applies them.

changes.reason: Timestamps are recorded in UTC only; the line about an operator timezone was removed. No other procedure rule changed.

reverseEdit.audited: - UTC start and completion timestamps; operator timezone separately if useful.

reverseEdit.current: The date in a report's file name is the UTC completion date.
reverseEdit.audited: Filenames keep the existing convention: `audit-18-2026-09-18.md` and `audit-18-2026-09-18.json`, with at least two digits for the audit number. The date is the UTC completion date.
